collection.title: Smart ForTwo Coupe 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Smart ForTwo Coupe 2014 Onwards requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 14" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have rear blade for this ForTwo, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
